title: Mesabi Metallics to build a $15B lower-carbon steel mill in Iowa

meta.summary: The company behind America’s first new iron ore mine in 50 years has unveiled plans for a massive, $15 billion steel plant in southeast Iowa, bringing the firm closer to realizing its ambitious vision for low-carbon steelmaking.
